name: BlueSPite
description: BlueSPite — ตัวกลางเชื่อม Shopee และ Google Flow เข้ากับเว็บ BlueSPite ที่รันบนเครื่องคุณ

content_scripts.comment: MAIN-world fetch helper. Shopee's API rejects requests that lack the headers its own client sets, so the actual fetch has to run in the page context (same approach ref3's injected-script and ref2's grok-api.js take). shopee.js (ISOLATED) drives it over window.postMessage.

MAIN-world direct-API client for Google Flow. Runs the SAME HTTP calls Flow's own web app makes (session token, project create, image upload, R2V generate/poll, media URL resolve) — see the header comment in flow-api.js for the verified endpoint list. Needs the page context for grecaptcha.enterprise and same-origin cookies. flow.js (ISOLATED) drives it over window.postMessage.
